newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada regional pilots to strike.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada regional pilots to strike.

text.p: Some 900 pilots from Air Canada's regional airlines were set to strike at 0300 EST/0700 GMT on Friday after a final attempt to settle a labour dispute with the company failed late on Thursday, the Canadian Air Line Pilots Association (CALPA) said.
CALPA represents pilots from Air Nova, Air Alliance, Air Ontario and AirBC in their talk with the Air Canada Regional Management.

"In meetings between CALPA and Air Canada and the Air Canada Pilots Association, no proposal for settlement was submitted by Air Canada, and CALPA's proposal for resolving the issue of fair and equitable access to work in the Air Canada system still has not been addressed by Air Canada," the union said in a statement.
It said the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service had told the CALPA negotiators that Air Canada and the Air Canada Pilots Association would not meet with them before January 15.
CALPA said its negotiators would remain available for meetings with the company at any time.
"Meanwhile, the previously announced strike by the 900 Air Canada Regional Airline pilots will begin across Canada simultaneously at 3 a.m. Eastern Standard Time, January 10," the union said.
